I have done an SLI 970 averages in a couple of games @3440x1440 minus Overwatch @2560x1440. Here they are:

BF4:  min: 63 Max: 173 AVG: 109  (MAX SETTINGS)   

GTAV Benchmark: Min: 61 Max: 271 AVG: 130 (Very High)   
GTAV Gameplay: Min:  23 MAX: 270 AVG: 105 (Believe the low 23 is due to the RAM limitation at VERY HIGH graphics for GTAV as it game a lot of stutters)

Star Wars BF: min: 54 Max: 114 AVG: 91 (Max Settings)   

Overwatch: Min: 104 MAx: 222 AVG: 162 (max settings)    

All games were tested in IN-GAME environments with Multiplayer besides GTA V. I would not run all very high with GTA V, put some settings on high and you will be golden. But as you can see 970 SLI still proves to be the king until better driver support and 3rd party cards. 

In my opinion, if you have a 970 and can run SLI pick up another 970 because right now it is faster than the 1080. Down the road with better driver support... only time will tell.
